description: This PHP source file defines a script for sending support notifications via email to contacts whose support end dates are approaching, either in a week or a month. It uses classes and functions for email templates, logging, and database interactions to generate and dispatch emails based on support end dates.

methods.name: showstatus
methods.description: Displays the status of mail sending operation, indicating success, failure, or no matches.

methods.name: getcontent_month
methods.description: Fetches the email subject and body content for monthly support notifications, merging contact and user data into email templates.

methods.name: getcontent_week
methods.description: Fetches the email subject and body content for weekly support notifications, merging contact and user data into email templates.
